{{Quote|Who doesn't love a good proteinloaf?|Dexter Jettster in the menu of Dex's Diner|<ref name="Dex" />}}
'''Proteinloaf''' was a dish served at the [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="Dex" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> One order of proteinloaf came with three slices of the dish along with [[brown dwarf gravy]] and cost 7.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. The diner's owner, [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], wrote in the menu that their proteinloaf was made from a tried-and-true recipe. He also described it as succulent.<ref name="Dex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Proteinloaf was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," a [[2009]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]-exclusive article which was written by [[Gregory Walker]] and formatted as an [[in-universe]] menu.<ref name="Dex" /> In Walker's [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: Blogs|Blog]], he described it as ''[[Star Wars]]''-style [[Wikipedia:Meatloaf|meatloaf]].<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|narbflick|11|Dining at Dex's: The Story Behind the Story}}</ref>
